description: Outreach playbooks for the LinkupAPI app: build a target list from your connected professional-network account, verify decision makers, send connection requests and follow-up messages at a safe pace, and mine post engagers as warm leads.

capabilities: Turn a product pitch into an ICP and a list of target companies and decision makers
Verify each prospect's current role before inviting, so ex-employees never get a message
Send connection requests and messages from your own account with daily caps and pacing
Find warm leads among the people who engaged with posts on your topic
Find and validate professional emails, then send from your connected mailbox
defaultPrompt: Run an outreach campaign: 25 CTOs at 50-200 person SaaS companies in France, personalized invite note.
Find warm leads among people who commented on recent posts about cold email deliverability.
interface.longDescription: Two step-by-step playbooks that make the LinkupAPI app run outreach the way a careful SDR would, from the professional-network account and mailbox you connected. Outreach campaign: turn a brief into an ICP, find matching companies and their decision makers, verify each person's current role before spending a credit on them, check the existing relationship, then send connection requests and follow-up messages at a pace that keeps your account safe, with email as an optional second channel. Warm leads from posts: find posts on your topic, pull the people who commented or reacted, score them against your ICP and reach out with a note that references the post. Every send is confirmed with you first, daily caps are enforced, and credits are spent only on the shortlist you approve. Requires the LinkupAPI app installed in ChatGPT with at least one connected account.

name: linkupapi-outreach
